collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Saloon 1998 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall Astra Saloon 1998 to 2004 model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
